name: DeepSeek Search
description: DeepSeek native web search provider for the managed web_search tool.

webSearch.apiKey.label: DeepSeek API key
webSearch.apiKey.help: Bearer token for api.deepseek.com. Falls back to DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in the Gateway environment.

webSearch.maxResults.label: Max results
webSearch.maxResults.help: Default result count when the tool call does not pass one (1-50).

webSearch.needContent.label: Return page content by default
webSearch.needContent.help: Sends need_content: true. Slower and produces much larger responses.

webSearch.cacheTtlMinutes.label: Cache TTL (minutes)
webSearch.cacheTtlMinutes.help: In-memory cache for identical queries. 0 disables caching.
